acceptedAnswer.text: While general building codes for handrails primarily apply to stairs and ramps in common areas, bedroom-specific handrails are often considered an accessibility or safety modification. However, local regulations in areas like Daly City or South San Francisco may have specific requirements for installation, especially if they are part of a larger renovation or impact structural elements. It's always advisable to consult with a qualified contractor who is familiar with local building codes to ensure proper and safe installation that meets all applicable standards.
